I posted the bullets in #coastal-team as a reply to your message. They cover:

- PHL here means Pellow Home Living, formerly Covey & Lark Retail (renamed 16 Feb 2026, CRM code CLR to PHL).
- PHL is also Pellucid Harbor Logistics, so check the account before filing tickets or filtering.
- The saved report "Covey — Late Arrivals" still needs the Pellow Home Living label.
- Older yard reports and the Pemberline Dock export can still show Covey & Lark Retail.

I haven't drafted an email to June. If you want one, I can save it as a draft in your mailbox for you to send.
